entrance.name: Newaygo County Parks Motor Vehicle Permit

values.note: 2026, one rate for everyone: electric sites $25 Monday-Wednesday, $30 Thursday-Sunday; water and electric $29 / $34; rustic sites $15 / $20. Holidays and special events +$5 a night. 21-day and seasonal rates are posted too. $5 reservation fee per reservation; a Newaygo County Parks Motor Vehicle Permit is required for every vehicle each day ($8 daily, $24 three-day, $35 annual).

fees.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ (page modified 2025-11-19; '2026 Camping Fees', White Cloud County Park: columns 'Nightly (Th-Su)', 'Nightly (M-W) Non-Holiday', '21-Day Rate', 'Seasonal'; Campsite (Water/Electric) $34 $29 $642 $1,550; Campsite (Electric) $30 $25 $567 $1,400; Campsite (Rustic) $20 $15 $378; 'Reservation fee (Applies to all reservations) - $5.00'; 'Daily MVP- $8'; 'HOLIDAYS AND SPECIAL EVENTS ASSESSED AN ADDITIONAL $5.00 PER NIGHT') + https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/white-cloud-park/ (page modified 2025-10-15; the same table), read 2026-10-25. The two columns are weekday/weekend, not resident/non-resident as the old note implied. The base is the electric site: whether the rustic sites take an RV is not stated.

hookups.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/white-cloud-park/ ('This park offers 86 campsites, with electricity and many with water') + https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ ('Campsite (Water/Electric)' class), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/white-cloud-park/ ('clean restrooms & hot showers, a dump station'; 'Non-camper use of sanitation station $25'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Online reservations (Firefly) open January 5 at 9 am for the year. Online bookings need 2 nights (3 on holidays); a 1-night stay is booked by calling the park (231-689-2021 in season). Payment in full when booking; holiday reservations are non-refundable. Seasonal sites by waiting list (231-689-7340).

booking.source: https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/rates-fees/ ('2026 Reservations Begin Online January 5th, 2026 at 9:00 AM EST!'; 'All campsite and cabin reservations require a 2-night minimum (3 nights on holidays)'; 'For 1-night reservations, you must call your Park of choice for a reservation'; 'payments are due in full at the time the reservation is made'; 'Holiday Cancelations ... are non-refundable') + https://www.newaygocountymi.gov/departments/parks/white-cloud-park/ ('Click here to make Park Reservation Online' -> https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/WCCountyPark; 'Seasonal campsites are available through a waiting list system ... Park Headquarters at 231.689.7340'; 'Contact During Camping Season (5/1-10/11) ... (231) 689-2021') + https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/WCCountyPark ('Holidays are assessed an additional $5.00 per night and require a 3-night minimum'), read 2026-10-25

note: Newaygo County park in the village of White Cloud on the White River, with a river walkway and a connector trail (past Flowing Wells Park and its artesian well) to the North Country National Scenic Trail; the town beach and swim area, restaurants and shops are nearby. Playground, a large enclosed pavilion with kitchen and fireplace, picnic shelter; group sites and a camping cabin. ORVs may use the park roads (with a Motor Vehicle Pass). --Claude
summary: Newaygo County park page + 2026 Rates & Fees page (modified 2025-11-19) + Firefly booking page: fees changed 15/34 -> 25/34 (2026; the base is now the electric site at $25 M-W, rustic $15 kept in the note; the two rate columns are weekday/weekend, not resident/non-resident - one rate for everyone), $5 reservation fee and $8/day vehicle permit (confirmed); 86 sites (confirmed), water at many (new), showers/dump (confirmed); season changed 'not year-round' -> May 1 - Oct 11 ('Camping Season (5/1-10/11)'); reservable online (confirmed) with a 2-night minimum online (3 on holidays) - 1-night stays by phone. Firefly search is behind reCAPTCHA and 2027 bookings open in January, so no quote. Seasonal sites by waiting list; their number is not posted (rates show seasonal pricing for water/electric and electric classes), so the nightly share is unknown - the 86-site park sells nights online and by phone. Phone (admin office 231-689-7340) matches; in-season park office is 231-689-2021. Note trimmed of field restatements and the wrong 'April-November'.
